notes: **Item D2 of the Discussion voice review: §3.** Two changes; the rest of §3 (heritability and mapping, the β-glucan and canonical-gene paragraph) reads well and is left as is.

**Heading (point 1):** the heading still carried both versions: "Heritability and GWAS reveal different aspects of genetic architecture / suggested: Genetic architecture of grain composition". Since review item 3 (27.9), the section holds three paragraphs: heritability vs mapping, rare alleles and carrier origin, and β-glucan and the canonical genes. The old title fits only the first; the suggested one covers all three. I propose the suggested one; see Q1.

**¶2, the carrier-origin logic (point 4):** "Plausible gene functions further support individual loci, although the haplotypes … came mainly from several desert populations … The 7H locus … therefore provides the clearest case." The "although" hid the step that leads to "therefore". It now reads: "Plausible gene functions further support individual loci. For the candidate genes, however, the allelic effect is harder to separate from geographic origin: the haplotypes … The 7H locus … therefore provides the clearest case." Same facts.
**Checked, no change:** the double space after "(Fig. 2a)." is only where a hidden note sits; it does not appear in Word.
